headline: E. Maui Regional Board (Water Authority)

meeting.summary: The East Maui Regional Board named its chair and vice chair to any East Maui irrigation system negotiations and adopted a motto.
meeting.recap: The East Maui Regional Board held its 15th meeting on December 12, 2024.[[0:00:34]] The chair said the state land board voted 5 to 2 on November 8, 2024, against starting a contested case (a formal hearing) on a long-term water license.[[0:03:43]] The board voted to meet in executive session (a closed-door discussion) on the negotiations item.[[0:05:18]] The two board representatives are to attend the meetings and report back to the board.[[0:12:51]] The board named the chair and vice chair as its two representatives.[[0:16:08]] The board was told it did not need to act yet on a draft vision statement.[[0:56:45]] The board discussed a state land board item on the East Maui irrigation system set for December 13, 2024.[[1:11:50]] The director said this state item is different from a long-term license.[[1:21:20]] The board voted to form a group of two to five members to draft review criteria for the director.[[1:36:54]] The board secretary said meetings in 2025 will stay monthly, on Thursdays at noon.[[1:44:46]]
decided: The board named the chair and vice chair as its two representatives, with the board keeping the ability to change this later.
The board voted to adopt a motto.
The board voted on a motion naming members of the performance criteria group.
meeting.next: The draft vision statement was suggested for the January agenda. The board secretary will add the adopted motto to the draft vision document. A report from the negotiation representatives will be on every board agenda.

moments.q: Vice chair asks members: what picture comes into your mind when you hear "watershed"?
Chair says the state item keeps something close to the status quo
